# Pain Research Forum

> A community-driven platform for curating, discussing, and advancing pain neuroscience research through peer-reviewed papers, expert commentary, and collaborative learning.

Pain Research Forum serves as a central hub for pain researchers, clinicians, and early-career scientists to access curated pain research papers, engage with editorial insights from leading experts like Patrik Ernfors and Allan Basbaum, and participate in webinars and multimedia content. The platform bridges basic neuroscience research with clinical applications, covering topics from gene expression and somatosensory mechanisms to opioid responses and drug development.

## Key Topics

- Pain neuroscience
- Basic research
- Chronic pain
- Somatosensory system
- Gene expression
- Opioid responses
- Drug development
- Artificial intelligence
- IASP (International Association for the Study of Pain)
- Editorial insights
- Community engagement
- Webinars
- Peer-reviewed research
- Early-career researchers
- Funding opportunities

## Research Papers & Archives

- [Papers Archive](https://painresearchforum.org/paper): Archive of pain research papers and editors' picks.
- [Papers by Week](https://painresearchforum.org/papers-by-week): Chronological index of pain research papers organized by week.
- [Editors' Picks Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/paper-category/editors-pick): Curated archive of editor-selected pain research papers.
- [Basic Research Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/paper-category/basic-research): Archive of basic pain research papers on genetics and neuroscience.
- [Classic Papers Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/paper-category/classic-papers): Archive of classic peer-reviewed pain neurobiology papers.

## News, Insights & Multimedia

- [News Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/news): Pain research news and editorial insights from experts.
- [Articles Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/news/articles): Archive of articles on pain research and drug development.
- [The Transmitter Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/the-transmitter): The Transmitter neuroscience news and pain research curation.
- [Multimedia Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/multimedia): Podcasts, webinars, and interviews on pain research topics.
- [PRF Webinar Series Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/prf-webinar-series): Pain Research Forum webinar recordings and upcoming events.
- [Correspondents' Programs Archives](https://painresearchforum.org/news/naps-correspondents-program): North American Pain School correspondent interviews and patient stories.
